existing_features.title: Create a responsive marketing website for the business shown in the uploaded image, using the business name "IQRA COMMUNICATION" and positioning it as a mobile accessories + mobile recharge/service shop.
Add a homepage layout with clear sections: Hero (shop name + short tagline), Services, Products/Accessories highlight, Gallery (static images), and Contact (phone numbers and basic info).
Populate the Contact section with phone numbers visible in the uploaded image: "9053030920" and "7027835322" (formatting allowed, numbers must match). Add click-to-call links (tel:).
Add a simple "Inquiry" contact form (name, phone, message) that submits to the backend and shows success/error states.
Provide an admin page in the frontend that requires Internet Identity login and displays the stored inquiries in a table (newest first).
Apply a cohesive visual theme appropriate for a mobile shop brand: teal/green base with red accents, bold typography for headings, and clean card-based sections. Avoid blue/purple as primary colors.
Add generated static images as assets in frontend/public/assets/generated and use them in the hero and services/products sections.
